Realistic live-action cinematic look, Chinese xianxia period drama: practical film photography style, a dim winter night inside an old apothecary hut, amber oil-lamp lighting, cold blue snowlight leaking through the broken window behind, film grain, natural material textures on wood, ceramic, dried herbs and cloth. Lock the identity of <Picture 1> as Lu Xiu (陆修), a scholarly physician in a long dark robe; lock <Picture 2> as Su Niang (素娘), a pale young woman in a moon-white wide-sleeved gown; lock the environment of <Picture 3> as the apothecary hut with the wooden table, stone medicine bowl, oil lamp and the broken window with drying herbs.

Scene overview: a single unbroken shot, constant speed, one take. Lu Xiu sits on a stool at the left side of the table, leaning sideways over a stone medicine bowl, grinding herbs with a wooden pestle; Su Niang stands one step from the table's right side, holding a steaming coarse-ceramic bowl of hot soup with both hands. They are about one meter apart.

Storyboard (one continuous fixed-camera shot):
[0s-3s] Lu Xiu lowers his head grinding herbs, the pestle turning steadily in the stone bowl; Su Niang steps forward with unnaturally light, floating footsteps, sets the bowl on the table edge, steam curling from the rim.
[3s-6s] Su Niang speaks with a faint forced smile, just as the bowl is about to settle: <d>[Chinese] 先生……怎么了？先把这碗黄精汤喝了吧，山里天寒，你身子——</d> Before she finishes, Lu Xiu's three fingers close around her wrist, pressing the cun-guan-chi pulse points; the pestle freezes mid-air.
[6s-10s] Lu Xiu's gaze lifts from the bowl to her face, then drops back to her wrist, voice lowered: <d>[Chinese] 素娘，把袖子挽起来。</d> Su Niang's other hand instinctively pulls her sleeve to hide her wrist, but he grips it firmly.
[10s-15s] Su Niang: <d>[Chinese] 先生今日好生奇怪，男女有别，你向来最知礼数……</d> Lu Xiu suddenly raises his head, bloodshot eyes fixed on her, demanding word by word: <d>[Chinese] 礼数？我问你，你的脉呢？！</d> Her smile freezes at the corner of her mouth; she turns her head away.

Camera: 47° diagonal field of view, standard-lens optical character, camera about 3.5 meters from the subjects, natural perspective; the foreground wooden table is sharp, the background broken window and air-dried herbs are readable. Chest-height, locked-off fixed position, slight top-down angle on the table; Lu Xiu occupies the left third of frame, Su Niang the right third, the oil lamp centered. One take, no cuts, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, constant speed.

Physics: Su Niang's footsteps are extremely light and floating; her moon-white wide sleeves lag and drift behind her turning; the bowl lands on the table with a soft thunk and the hot soup ripples; when the pestle stops, Lu Xiu's knuckles tighten and the veins on the back of his hand stand out.

Lighting: warm amber oil-lamp light from the center of the table lights both faces, falling off softly into the dark corners; the cold blue snowlight through the back window is the only cool color. No flat frontal lighting.

Audio: howling winter wind outside the window, faint crackle of the lamp wick, the soft thunk of the bowl, the ripple of the soup, Su Niang's soft voice, Lu Xiu's low voice.

Negative: no subtitles, no music, no text, no watermarks, no logo; both characters present from the first frame; no camera movement, no scene cuts, no animation or cartoon rendering, keep the live-action texture.
